support_state_policy.supported: The artifact builds, the extension loads (extension-load smoke passes), the exported package for both debug and release actually bundles the native library (export smoke), and the applicable multiplayer/integration smoke test passes for this target's role (client: headless integration tests; server: the dedicated-server startup/session smoke plus the multi-peer conformance suite). Only then may release notes, store listings, or documentation call a target supported.
support_state_policy.experimental: The artifact builds and there is direct evidence it loads (extension-load smoke passed for at least one build type), but export smoke and/or the role-applicable multiplayer/integration smoke test have not yet passed for this exact entry. Usable for development; not to be advertised to end users as a supported target.
support_state_policy.planned: Declared intent only: no artifact has been built for this target in the environment that produced this manifest, or (server role) the dedicated-server-specific smoke tests have not run against it.

symbols_policy.build_flags_today: SConstruct appends -g for every GDExtension build on macOS/iOS/Linux/Android/Web, and /Zi plus /DEBUG on Windows, for BOTH template_debug and template_release -- there is no per-build-type branch that omits it. Every artifact this repository builds today, release included, embeds full debug symbols.
symbols_policy.current_behavior: No stripping step runs anywhere in this repository today. Neither tools/checksums.py, tools/ga_checksums.py, tools/export_smoke.sh, tools/ga_export_smoke.sh, nor any .github/workflows/ci.yml job invokes a symbol-stripping, dsymutil, or side-car step for either addon. Every file presently in addons/gameplay_abilities/bin/ -- both the debug and the release macOS artifact -- carries embedded, unstripped debug symbols. The SConstruct comment that release symbols are 'stripped into a side-car by tools/package_release.py' describes an intended future step, not current behavior: that file did not exist before task 12.1 and nothing invoked it.
symbols_policy.intended_policy: tools/ga_package_release.py (added by task 12.1) strips a release build's symbols into a '<artifact-filename>.debug' side-car file (dsymutil+strip on macOS/iOS, objcopy --only-keep-debug plus --strip-debug on Linux/Android, left as-is on Windows where /Zi already emits a separate .pdb, and left embedded on Web/wasm32 where no stripping tool is assumed present) when it packages a release artifact for distribution. Debug-build artifacts are never stripped by that script. This is the intended policy going forward; no artifact recorded in this manifest has actually been packaged through it yet, so every 'symbols' value below reads 'embedded'.

licenses.mandatory_third_party_runtime: None. Verified by auditing every #include across native/core, native/protocol, native/godot, and native/resources: beyond the C++ standard library and the godot-cpp binding (native/dependencies.json, MIT, shared with CommonUI's pinned checkout), no vendored third-party gameplay or networking library is included, linked, or required.
